meta.demand_definition: GB National Demand (ND): metered generation requirement excluding station load, pumping and exports; not total end-user demand
assumptions: Empty initial and final state every day
One-node model; no network, ramp, reserve, price or asset constraints
Forecast frozen from 2024; no 2025 outturn informs forecast policy
Hindsight LP is a perfect-information bound, not an operational policy
Revised annual data; not an as-issued vintage-certified backtest
meta.numerical_precision: Trajectories rounded to six decimal places in JSON; daily CSV uses full precision
meta.binding_definition: A resource bound is reached by this schedule; does not by itself establish marginal value
meta.throughput_definition: 0.5 hours times sum of absolute net flow; includes charging and discharging
